name: adidas Yeezy Desert Boot 'Oil' 2019
story_html: Borrowing the suede toe box and oval overlays from the Yeezy 500, 2019's Yeezy Desert Boot 'Oil' takes Kanye West's signature line into boot territory. The three-quarter cut upper comes in a smooth suede and mesh, with thick rope laces and an exaggerated mudguard. The chunky foam midsole pairs with a thick rugged outsole for outdoors-ready cushioning and traction. The entire silhouette comes in an earth-toned motif, with just a bit of branding on the bottom of the sole.
